selector-class-pattern.message: Expected class selector to be kebab-case (BEM `--` modifiers allowed, e.g. .cs-arrow--prev)

color-function-notation.message: Use rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), not rgb(0 0 0 / 55%). The platform's styleCode minifier is documented to fail on a modern function value inside a --x: declaration and then silently serve the last sheet that minified — and dist/paste/1-style-only.css goes straight into that field. stylelint-config-standard defaults this to "modern", which is why the rule is stated here.

alpha-value-notation.message: Write the alpha as 0.55, not 55% — same styleCode minifier reason as color-function-notation above.

color-function-alias-notation.message: Write rgba() when there is an alpha, not rgb() with four arguments — the playbook's rule is classic rgba(), and a four-argument rgb() is the same CSS Color 4 syntax the styleCode minifier is documented to reject.
